topic: Circle native USDC on XRPL, chain-specific supply and XRP value-capture boundaries

verified_facts.fact: Circle announced USDC live natively on XRPL mainnet on June 12, 2025. Circle Mint and Circle APIs support USDC on XRPL; Circle said no third-party bridge is required.
Circle's published XRPL mainnet asset identity is currency code 5553444300000000000000000000000000000000 and issuer rGm7WCVp9gb4jZHWTEtGUr4dd74z2XuWhE.

Circle's XRPL USDC page says qualified Circle Mint businesses can convert fiat directly to USDC on XRPL and redeem it back to fiat, and Circle Mint/APIs can move USDC between supported blockchains without a third-party bridge.
Circle's transparency page reports global USDC circulation of $70.0B and total reserves of $71.4B as of October 29, 2026.

chain_scope_and_capital_boundaries: The $70.0B global circulation figure is issuer-level across all supported chains, not XRPL-specific supply.
Native USDC issuance on XRPL is a direct Circle–XRPL relationship, but it does not mean USDC transfers require XRP as an intermediary.
Circle's documented Circle Mint cross-chain route is described as moving USDC between supported chains without a third-party bridge; do not model it as an XRP bridge route.
USDC/XRP DEX or AMM activity can create direct XRP pair turnover and liquidity, but pool TVL, gross volume and swap count are not net new XRP capital.
No synchronized, pinned-ledger XRPL USDC supply series is admitted in this artifact.

data_quality_and_access_controls.provider_discrepancy: Secondary XRPL token/index pages displayed materially different supply, market-cap, holder and turnover snapshots during the same research window. The raw values are not copied into this repository; they are not averaged or admitted as a feature.
data_quality_and_access_controls.xrpl_to_terms: XRPL.to's published API guidance requires visible attribution when its data is displayed and written permission before storing/re-serving its indexed data in another dataset or API. Do not ingest or persist XRPL.to indexed data in Barrot without that permission.
data_quality_and_access_controls.preferred_reconciliation: Use a documented read-only XRPL public-node RPC at a pinned validated ledger. Cross-check issuer account_info, account_lines and gateway_balances; preserve ledger index, ledger hash, capture timestamp, issuer/currency identity and any frozen/authorized settings. For AMM pools, use amm_info and transaction/ledger history; for order books, use book_offers with explicit pair and depth.
data_quality_and_access_controls.limitations: A current issuer-level or explorer balance without a pinned ledger index and complete issuer/holder accounting is not sufficient to establish chain supply, net issuance or market depth.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Native USDC on XRPL can increase dollar-denominated settlement utility and attract payment/application liquidity.
competing_hypotheses.support: Circle native issuance, Circle Mint access and Circle API support are confirmed.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limit: No admitted XRPL-specific supply/time series, payment-value series or net external capital series in this artifact.

competing_hypotheses.claim: USDC can substitute for XRP as the dollar-value transfer asset in some XRPL settlement paths.
competing_hypotheses.support: USDC is directly issued on XRPL and is redeemable through qualified Circle Mint access.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limit: Some cross-asset trades may still route through XRP for liquidity; no transaction-path attribution has been measured.

competing_hypotheses.claim: USDC/XRP DEX/AMM activity can create indirect XRP trading demand and fee activity.
competing_hypotheses.support: The pair is technically supported by the XRPL DEX/AMM and public market indexes show a live pair.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limit: Pool and turnover values are not reconciled to pinned-ledger reads; no causal price effect or net external capital is established.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Circle's crosschain API movement creates XRP bridge demand.
competing_hypotheses.support: Circle offers crosschain USDC movement and XRPL is one supported chain.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limit: Circle describes movement across supported chains without a third-party bridge; no evidence shows XRP is the intermediary.

feature_admission.circle_global_usdc_circulation: Issuer-level macro feature only; never label as XRPL supply.
feature_admission.xrpl_usdc_supply: Hold until direct pinned-ledger reconciliation and complete issuer accounting.
feature_admission.xrpl_usdc_xrp_amm: Admit only from pinned amm_info/ledger trades with timestamp and pair identity; separate pool reserves, swap volume, fees and LP concentration.
feature_admission.circle_crosschain_api: Categorical product capability only until chain-specific executed transfer data is available.

next_actions: Implement a read-only pinned-ledger RPC adapter for Circle's XRPL USDC issuer and validate account_lines/gateway_balances reconciliation.
Capture the validated ledger index/hash and all issuer settings relevant to transfer authorization, freeze and clawback semantics.
Enumerate XRP/USDC AMM pools and order-book depth from ledger-native reads; do not rely on unlicensed indexed snapshots.
Track USDC minted, redeemed, transferred, frozen and held on XRPL separately from global Circle circulation.
Measure whether USDC/XRP swaps use XRP as a route or merely trade against the pair; avoid inferring XRP demand from USDC issuance alone.

forecast.reason: No synchronized, pinned-ledger XRPL USDC feature series or calibrated out-of-sample XRP prediction evidence.
